tagline: The mother of the world — 21 million people beside the only surviving Wonder of the Ancient World.
overview: Cairo — 'the mother of the world' to Egyptians — is Africa's largest metro area and the only city on earth that can see an ancient Wonder from its edge: the Pyramids of Giza rise directly out of the city's western suburbs.

The new Grand Egyptian Museum at Giza (the world's largest museum devoted to one civilisation) houses the complete Tutankhamun collection; downtown, the old Egyptian Museum, Khan el-Khalili's medieval bazaar and the Citadel of Saladin layer 5,000 years into one skyline.
Speed's 2025 Africa tour streamed from Cairo to enormous crowds. The pyramids, the Nile feluccas at sunset and the cacophony of a city of 21 million make it travel's greatest sensory overload.
